GB:description.value:
These wireless Bluetooth earbuds are designed for active lifestyles and everyday listening. Ideal for workouts, commuting, remote calls, or relaxing at home, they deliver stable audio performance without tangled wires. The secure-fit design stays comfortably in place during movement, while the compact charging case ensures portability and on-the-go power.

Key features include Bluetooth 5.3 for fast pairing and reliable connectivity up to 10 metres, up to 40 hours of total playtime (with case), IPX5-rated water resistance for sweat and light rain protection, and intuitive touch controls for play/pause, track skipping, call handling, and voice assistant activation. Each earbud houses a built-in microphone for clear hands-free calls.

The earbuds feature an ergonomic in-ear structure with soft silicone ear tips for long-wearing comfort. Touch controls respond reliably with light taps—no buttons to press or slide. Charging is simple via USB-C port on the case; a full charge takes approximately 1.5 hours. For maintenance, gently wipe earbuds and case with a dry, lint-free cloth—avoid liquids, solvents, or abrasive materials.

The package includes the wireless earbuds, matching charging case, three sizes of silicone ear tips (S/M/L), and a USB-C charging cable. TikTok Shop GB offers standard delivery across the UK and supports returns in accordance with platform policies. All items are covered by the manufacturer’s limited warranty as applicable under UK consumer law.

  • Bluetooth version: 5.3
  • Total battery life: Up to 40 hours (with charging case)
  • Water resistance rating: IPX5
  • Control method: Touch control
  • Charging interface: USB-C
  • Included accessories: Ear tips (S/M/L), USB-C cable, charging case
